description: Source code for managing DU cells in a 5G network, including configuration, reconfiguration, and control of DU cell states, with functions for adding, starting, stopping, and removing cells, as well as handling system information updates and RRM policies.

classes.name: du_cell_manager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing DU cells, including configuration, reconfiguration, and lifecycle control.

methods.name: fill_si_scheduler_config
methods.description: Populates the SI scheduling configuration based on cell configuration and system information messages.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new DU cell with specified configuration, generating system information and scheduling configs.

methods.name: handle_cell_reconf_request
methods.description: Handles reconfiguration requests for a DU cell, updating parameters and policies, and triggering necessary updates.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Asynchronously starts a DU cell, transitioning it to active state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Asynchronously stops a DU cell, transitioning it to inactive state.

methods.name: stop_all
methods.description: Stops all active DU cells asynchronously.

methods.name: remove_all_cells
methods.description: Removes all DU cells, ensuring they are inactive before removal.

methods.name: get_cell_index
methods.description: Retrieves the index of a DU cell based on its NR CGI or PCI.
